description: Source code for an HTTP parser implementation based on nginx's http parser, adapted for Zephyr RTOS. Contains parsing logic, macros, error handling, and callback mechanisms for HTTP message processing.

methods.name: http_parser_init
methods.description: Initializes the HTTP parser with specified type (request or response).

methods.name: http_parser_execute
methods.description: Executes the parser on given data buffer, processing HTTP message.

methods.name: http_message_needs_eof
methods.description: Determines if the message requires EOF to end.

methods.name: http_should_keep_alive
methods.description: Checks if the connection should be kept alive based on HTTP version and headers.

methods.name: http_method_str
methods.description: Returns string representation of HTTP method enum.

methods.name: http_parser_settings_init
methods.description: Initializes parser settings with default callbacks.

methods.name: http_errno_name
methods.description: Returns the name of an error code.

methods.name: http_errno_description
methods.description: Provides description for an error code.

methods.name: http_body_is_final
methods.description: Checks if the message body has been fully received.

methods.name: http_parser_version
methods.description: Returns the version of the parser library.
